_: Run presets for base tools/boot/boot.py --game hwaoc. Paths are relative to the data folder (games/hwaoc) or use {data} {game} {run} {nx}. boot.py adds RomFS, save folder, shader and BC7 caches itself. Env the game needs on every run is in its config_defaults (runtime/hwaoc_core.cpp), not here.

title._: fresh save to the title screen with scripted pad input (tt/title.tt)

fps._: the title run into the prologue battle, then the frame-step speed check (tt/fps.tt); set NXRT_TIME_MAX_RATE for the rate

movies._: fresh save, the first-run screen, then the movies play to the end into the prologue battle (tt/movies.tt)

res._: fresh save into the prologue battle, two shots there (tt/res.tt); set the size with --env NXRT_BOOT_HEADLESS_WIDTH=.. --env NXRT_BOOT_HEADLESS_HEIGHT=..

kbm._: fresh save, first-run screen by keys, movies skipped, the prologue battle with WASD, mouse camera and mouse-button attacks (tt/kbm.tt)
